facts.fact: The project's first-phase consultations with provincial and municipal bodies, held from May 2019 to February 2020, found as a main finding a lack of electricity, of an internet connection and of computer equipment for running services at local level; no number of municipal administrations is given (the country has 164 municipalities).

systems.tiers: to be adopted and used for preparing and executing municipal budgets in the 58 target municipalities; planned under subcomponent 2A

systems.owner: National Public Procurement Service (SNCP), under MINFIN
